input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it either stops working or is extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone, especially since I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me fix this?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need anything else to get started.
The issue is with my phone number 555-123-2002. That’s the line where my mobile data is either not working or is very slow. I’d appreciate your help in getting this fixed!
On my phone’s status bar, I see the airplane mode icon and a VPN icon. I don’t see any network signal strength bars or any icons like “4G”, “5G”, “LTE”, or “E”. What should I do next?

I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now, I see one bar for signal strength (which looks poor), a “2G” icon, and it says data is disabled. There’s still a VPN icon as well. What should I do next? My mobile data still isn’t working.

I’ve turned on mobile data. Now, the status bar shows one bar for signal strength (still poor), “2G”, and data is enabled. The VPN icon is still there as well. My mobile data is still not working properly—what should I try next?

I’ve changed the network mode to “4G/5G preferred.” Now, my status bar shows excellent signal strength, a “5G” icon, and data is enabled. The VPN icon is still there. Should I try using my mobile data now, or is there anything else I should do?

I disconnected the VPN, and my status bar still shows excellent signal strength, “5G,” and data enabled. However, when I tried to test my internet speed, it said there was no connection. My mobile data still isn’t working. What should I do next?

I reset the APN settings and rebooted my phone, but when I tried to use my mobile data, I still got a “no connection” message during the speed test. My status bar still shows excellent signal strength, “5G,” and data enabled. What should I try next? This is getting a bit frustrating.
